author: Bethesda Softworks
description:
Discover new stories, adventures, challenges, and rewards with The Elder Scrolls Online Season One, Return of the Thieves Guild.

Prepare to pilfer Glenumbra as part of a new Thieves Guild storyline, take a vacation with Sheogorath, the God of Madness himself, plunder the ocean’s depth during the High Seas of Tamriel event, unlock seasonal rewards via a new Tamriel Tome, and more. The Elder Scrolls Online Season One is now live from July 8 until October 21 and is free for all ESO players—see you in Tamriel!
